title: Entity Solr Document (v3)
description: Entity Solr document in the v3 representation: one document per non-null Wikidata QID across accepted body and title occurrences in the indexed population. It preserves supplied language-specific labels and a display default, records a selected NER type, and distinguishes linked-occurrence counts from distinct-content-item counts.

id.description: Unique Wikidata identifier of the entity.

default_label_s.description: Required display label. Prefer the English label, then an accepted label matching the selected Wikipedia reference language, then an accepted other or remaining available label, and finally the Wikipedia page name. Across multiple references for a QID, prefer en, fr, de, then remaining language codes alphabetically, with exact page name as tie-break. The importer uses a versioned deterministic policy for any remaining label choice; absent labels do not create empty language-specific fields.

entitySuggest.description: Optional Solr suggester field documenting the labels exposed for entity auto-completion. It is populated by Solr configuration and is absent from generated documents. In other words: present only once indexed.

ner_entity_type_s.description: One NER type selected by maximum accepted linked-occurrence count across body and title. Among tied ordinary types (very unlikely), prefer loc, then pers, then org. Precedence involving media-source types belongs to the separately reviewed media contract. This field records one type and does not use a mixed value.

content_item_count_l.description: Integer number of distinct content items containing at least one accepted body or title occurrence linked to this QID. Count each content item once across text parts and NER types. Former field name: article_fq_f.

mention_count_l.description: Integer number of accepted body and title mention occurrences linked to this QID across the indexed population. Former field name: mention_fq_f.

ner_type_pers_count_l.description: Integer number of accepted body and title occurrences linked to this QID with NER type pers.

ner_type_loc_count_l.description: Integer number of accepted body and title occurrences linked to this QID with NER type loc.

ner_type_org_count_l.description: Integer number of accepted body and title occurrences linked to this QID with NER type org.

ner_type_pressagency_count_l.description: Integer number of accepted body and title occurrences linked to this QID with NER type pressagency.

ner_type_radiostation_count_l.description: Integer number of accepted body and title occurrences linked to this QID with NER type radiostation.

suggest_payload_s.description: Required importer-built Solr suggester payload containing the document id followed by a literal pipe and ner_entity_type_s: QID|type.

scopes_ss.description: Optional presence scopes for this entity: the union of body/title text parts containing accepted occurrences linked to this QID. Emit body before title when both are present. Scopes do not split entity identity or counts; occurrence counts combine both parts and distinct-content-item counts use their union.

^label_(?:en|fr|de|it|es|pt|nl|lb|rm|ca|.description: Entity label in the specified supported language (ISO 639-1 code).
